Commentary.Commentary: And that's a wrap! The West Indies have ended their Bangladesh tour on a high note, winning the T20I series 3-0 after Bangladesh took the ODI series 2-1. It was an exciting tour with a lot of learning and findings for both sides. Now, Bangladesh gears up to host Ireland, while the Windies prepare for their tour of New Zealand. Until next time, cheers!

The skipper of West Indies and Player Of The Match, Roston Chase, praised Ackeem Auguste, saying he's shown positive signs and deserved his place in the team. Chase mentioned having a chat with Ackeem to play his natural game and he will anchor the innings, which paid off. Chase also acknowledged their fielding lapses but was happy with the total they restricted Bangladesh to.

Romario Shepherd is the Player Of The Series. Romario Shepherd revealed that he was unaware of the hat-trick until his teammates informed him, and he was too focused on completing his overs to celebrate. He praised his teammates, particularly Roston Chase, the captain, and youngster Ackeem Auguste, for their impressive batting, which bodes well for the team's future.

Litton Das, the skipper of Bangladesh, attributed the loss to factors beyond their control, pointing out the difference in conditions during Bangladesh's batting and bowling innings. He felt the Windies benefited from dew during Bangladesh's bowling innings, which made it tough for his team. He praised Tanzid's batting and acknowledged that the Windies executed their plans well, but also mentioned the impact of dropped catches. Das concluded by saying that they'll take the learnings from this series and will work hard to get the result next time.
Presentation...

Earlier, Bangladesh scored 151, thanks to a brilliant knock from Tanzid Hasan. Romario Shepherd claimed a hat-trick and was sensational with the ball. Bangladesh got off to a shaky start, losing two early wickets, before Tanzid Hasan and Saif Hassan added 63 runs for the third wicket. Tanzid scored 89, but his dismissal triggered a collapse, with Shepherd's hat-trick and contributions from Jason Holder, Khary Pierre, Akeal Hosein, and Roston Chase restricting Bangladesh to a modest total.

Bangladesh's bowling was underwhelming, with Taskin Ahmed and Rishad Hossain struggling to contain the Windies' batting lineup. Despite Rishad's 3 wickets, he was expensive and failed to create the impact his side needed. Nasum and Mahedi each picked up a wicket, but it wasn't enough to stop the Windies' victory.

The Windies chased down 152 with ease, thanks to some solid batting. Amir Jangoo set the tone with aggressive batting, with Roston Chase and Ackeem Auguste carrying on the momentum, scoring half-centuries each. Amir Jangoo contributed 34 crucial runs before getting out at the top. The Windies' batting unit performed well to seal the win and the way they countered spin was so refreshing to see.

The West Indies have wrapped up the series in style, winning the final match by 5 wickets and clinching the series 3-0. They've been convincing and comprehensive throughout, showcasing their skill and dominance even with a mix of young and old. A well-deserved win for the Windies.
